title: Renewable Energy
meta_description: Renewable operators industrialize asset performance: turbine and inverter health, generation forecasting, PPA settlement and hybrid-plant optimization.

blocks.x: Renewable Energy: the operating units, priority programs and the five capability towers that matter most here.

The workflows we industrialize here: Fleet maintenance, Generation forecasting, PPA/GO settlement, Hybrid optimization, O&M logistics. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Turbines/inverters fail unscheduled; availability points lost.
Generation forecasts feed trading poorly; imbalance costs.
Technician routing and parts by spreadsheet; weather windows missed.
Settlement data assembly per contract; disputes slow.
Avoided-emissions claims unverified; buyers demand proof.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: Turbine/inverter telemetry with failure modes: availability up
Asset-level generation forecasts into trading: imbalance down
Goal-directed agents that run inside your systems with defined roles, budgets and human checkpoints. Every action is logged, measurable and reversible.
Permissioned networks, tokenization and verifiable credentials with the reporting and controls supervisors expect.
PPA/GO data pipelines with evidence: disputes down

blocks.x: Every engagement opens with the baseline measurement pack — cycle times, error rates and unit costs for the workflows above. Every committed outcome on this page is reported against that locked baseline, and the baseline is audited annually.

items: Forecast error down 31%: imbalance cost recovered across three control zones
Turnaround duration down 14%: scheduling optimization at refinery scale
